interactions.note: The epitope of Fab/IgE 2F5 on Hev b 8 was determined from the crystal structure of the complex. A construct of rHev b 8, with a short peptide (DDDK-rHev b 8), was used to promote crystallization of the complex. Two X-ray crystal structures of the complex, at 3.04 (this structure) and 3.34 [PDB: 7SBG] Å resolution, were obtained from crystals that grew in different conditions. Both complexes crystallized in the orthorhombic space group P212121 with one copy of the Fab/IgE 2F5-proﬁlin complex in the asymmetric unit.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 3.04 angstroms
